items.headline: Gen10 launches chat-driven CTRM assistant
items.summary: Gen10 introduced a chat-driven CTRM feature called NaNi, reflecting a broader push toward conversational AI interfaces in commodity trading software, per CTRM Center coverage.

items.headline: ACER opens REMIT II reporting consultation
items.summary: ACER launched a public consultation on an annex to its REMIT transaction reporting guideline covering energy derivative contracts, part of the phased rollout of REMIT II obligations that entered into force on 29 April 2026.

items.headline: Red Sea diversions and blockade risk widen
items.summary: Flexport's weekly update flagged a Saudi-linked blockade as a distinct risk from ongoing Red Sea diversions, with blank sailings on some lanes expected to jump sharply and Cape of Good Hope routing still advised through Q3.

items.headline: Commodity trade finance market seen doubling by 2030
items.summary: A new market report projects commodity trade finance growing from about $59.7bn in 2026 to $81.45bn by 2030, driven by blockchain-based settlement and real-time risk monitoring adoption, per GlobeNewswire.
